paragraphs: Prince Elijah Abumoye, born September 5th, 1994, is the visionary entrepreneur and founder of Traction Outsourcing Limited. He is a seasoned business leader, author, corporate trainer, and senior executive with extensive hands-on leadership experience, including past executive roles as a Chief Operating Officer (COO) and Country Head of HR for a multinational organization working across Nigeria, Rwanda, and Dubai. Through Traction Outsourcing, Traction Properties, and ATH Recruiters, he has worked with several businesses across Nigeria.

Prince Elijah holds a BSc from the University of Lagos. With a strong foundation in corporate governance, workforce collaboration, and strategic human resource development, Prince Elijah leverages his rich background to help businesses establish structures and high-performing teams across Nigeria.

entries.a: Prince Elijah Abumoye is the founder of Traction Outsourcing Limited, as well as Traction Properties and ATH Recruiters. He is a business leader, author, and corporate trainer with past executive experience as a Chief Operating Officer (COO) and Country Head of HR for a multinational organization operating in Nigeria, Rwanda, and Dubai.

entries.q: What companies does Prince Elijah Abumoye lead?
entries.a: He leads three companies: Traction Outsourcing Limited, which handles HR and management consulting, staff outsourcing, corporate restructuring, and business advisory; Traction Properties, a real estate brokerage and property management brand in Abuja; and ATH Recruiters (Abuja Talent Hub), an affordable recruitment and staffing agency.

entries.q: What is Prince Elijah Abumoye's professional background?
entries.a: He holds a BSc from the University of Lagos and built his background in corporate governance, workforce collaboration, and strategic HR development through senior executive roles, including COO and Country Head of HR positions for a multinational organization working across Nigeria, Rwanda, and Dubai.

entries.q: How can I get in touch with Prince Elijah Abumoye's team?
entries.a: The fastest way is to book a free 30-minute clarity call through the WhatsApp link on this page. His team will discuss what your business needs and connect you with the right service, whether that is Traction Outsourcing, Traction Properties, or ATH Recruiters.
